tasks.prompt: In spring-core, add a small utility method that returns the given string trimmed, or null when the string contains no visible text. Put it where such helpers belong and follow existing conventions.

In spring-core or spring-beans, add a helper that takes a fully-qualified class name and returns a new instance created via the default constructor, with sensible exceptions. Follow existing conventions.
In spring-core, add a helper that reports whether a given method or its declaring class carries a given annotation, including meta-annotations. Follow existing conventions.
In spring-core, add a helper that resolves the class of the first generic type argument of a given field, or null if it cannot be resolved. Follow existing conventions.
In one paragraph: trace what happens from ApplicationContext.getBean(String) down to the instantiation of a singleton bean — name the key classes in order. Do not modify any files.
In one paragraph: where are @Profile conditions evaluated during bean definition registration, and which types are involved? Do not modify any files.
In one paragraph: how does Spring MVC decide which HttpMessageConverter serializes a @ResponseBody return value? Name the key classes. Do not modify any files.
